question: Where’s the closest museum encountered when moving toward Black Point Inn, Scarborough, ME from Mount Washington Boat Terminal, Wolfeboro, NH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21302 43.583693)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.316658 43.533625)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21302 43.583693)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21302 43.583693)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Mount Washington Boat Terminal, Wolfeboro, NH
